method: Source MJO bytecode and known syscall-name resolution; no live game input

operands.string: の Sub Episode が追加されました

contracts.base: Read 80x13; wrap character cells at 6 content chars per 7-unit row and dates at 12 per13; stored in 0xcb8a8240; fontout at index274 and event draw consumers.
contracts.alt: Wrapped at12 per13 into0x67a5944b; used in hover-detail bubble.
contracts.exec: Only $-prefixed non-header cells are episode commands (strip leading $ into0xe750647c); row0 stored as notification display names and read at4028.
contracts.date_equality: Base column0 normalized by yazlib0x2d550638; ALT/EXEC normalized column0 must match base or native error dialog is raised. Translate all three in lockstep.
contracts.terminators: Preserve [EOF] exact including the extra final-column sentinels in ALT/EXEC.
contracts.quoted_linefeeds: Source has actual LF in quoted cells. file_read helper handles quoted segments; preserve quote shape and LF counts.
contracts.leading_check: Conservative target guard uses characters at or above U+3000 for base/alt starts; fullwidth digits and original-style corner quotes retained.
